jars: In the Day 5 'for you', the app says 'You are spending four hours a day overthinking' — I never said I spent four hours a day, I just said I overprepare.

The Day 1 script says 'the voice in your head tells you that your father's taxi is your ceiling' — I said 'whose dad drove a taxi', not that the taxi is my ceiling, which sounds a bit dismissive of my dad's hard work.
best: Even the strongest people freeze. The teaching begins there.
day1_verdict: This finally understands that my nausea is a sign my body cares, not that I'm failing.
